perm.mic.body: Needed to record your voice in speaking practice. The recording stays on your device.
perm.notif.title: Turn on reminders?

onboarding.s1.title: English, in one place
onboarding.s1.body: CEFR from the ground up to C1. Full IELTS exam prep. Both tracks in one app.
onboarding.s2.title: You pick the track
onboarding.s2.body: Each track has its own coach, its own exercises, its own results. You can switch later.
onboarding.s3.title: Practice. Feedback. Growth.
onboarding.s3.body: Short practice every day — AI feedback — real preparation.
onb.s1.headline: Choose your language
onb.s1.support: The app starts in your language. Change it any time.
onb.s2.headline: Welcome. In 30 seconds we'll pick the right path for you.
onb.s2.support: A few questions — we'll build a plan from your answers. No payment yet.
onb.s3.headline: Why do you want to learn English?
onb.s3.goal.dtm.sub: English is one of the DTM subjects
onb.s3.goal.work.sub: At a local or international company
onb.s4.headline: How soon do you want results?
onb.s5.headline: What's your current level?
onb.s5.support: Answer honestly — your plan is built around this.
onb.s6.q2.stem: If I ___ more time, I would learn Chinese.
onb.s6.q3.stem: The report, ___ was submitted yesterday, needs revision.
onb.s7.headline: Your level
onb.s7.aspiration: Good news: you can reach {nextBand} in {monthsText}. 250+ learners have walked this path.
onb.s7.body.A0: Starting from almost zero. That's fine. We'll walk step by step, alphabet first.
onb.s7.body.A1: You know some words and short phrases. Now we build sentences.
onb.s7.body.A2: You understand daily talk but struggle with more complex texts.
onb.s7.body.B1: You can speak fluently. Now we go deep on grammar and vocabulary.
onb.s7.body.B2: You're at a strong level. Ready for IELTS and study abroad.
onb.s7.body.C1: You're advanced. Now sharpen with mocks, essays, real conversations.
onb.s8.body.cefr: 0 → C1 daily plan. Grammar, vocabulary, writing, speaking — all in one place.
onb.s8.body.ielts: Official prep for all 4 IELTS sections. Real mock tests, band-score feedback.
onb.s9.headline: They started exactly where you are
onb.s9.t1.name: Aziza, 19
onb.s9.t1.quote: IELTS 7.5 in 3 months. 10 minutes a day was enough.
onb.s9.t2.name: Sardor, 22
onb.s9.t2.quote: 90/100 on DTM English. Got into university.
onb.s9.t3.name: Kamola, 26
onb.s9.t3.quote: A1 → B2 in 4 months. Now I speak English at work.
onb.s10.headline: How much time can you commit each day?
onb.s10.support: Small and consistent beats big and irregular. Same time each day.
onb.s11.headline: We'll save your plan — account for {track}

onb.s12.tier3.name: 12 months
onb.s12.footer: Secure payment via Payme or Click.

engnova.welcome.headline: Welcome
engnova.welcome.support: Learn English at your own pace. Practice, feedback, and plans in one place.
engnova.welcome.hint: Next step: sign in or create an account.
engnova.login.headline: Sign in
engnova.login.support: Pick one of three ways. Google and Telegram users set a password next.
engnova.login.notReady: The server isn't connected yet. App is still in development.
engnova.auth.err.google: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again.
engnova.auth.err.tg: Couldn't sign in with Telegram. Try again.
engnova.auth.err.tg.timeout: Telegram didn't respond. Did you tap Share in Telegram? Try again.
engnova.signup.headline: New account
engnova.signup.support: Create an email and password. 10 seconds.
engnova.signup.emailSent: We sent a confirmation email. Check your inbox.
engnova.signup.terms: By continuing you accept the Terms of Service.
engnova.signup.err.taken: This email is already registered. Tap Sign in.
engnova.signup.err.weak: Password must be at least 8 characters.
engnova.signup.err.unknown: Couldn't create the account. Try again.
engnova.setpw.headline: Set a password
engnova.setpw.support: Set a password so you can always sign in without Google or Telegram. The same password works in the app and on the site.
engnova.setpw.err.weak: Password must be at least 8 characters.
engnova.setpw.done.title: Password saved
engnova.setpw.done.body: You can now sign in with this password anytime.
engnova.home.placeholder: The full app is coming soon. You're already signed in — your account is saved.
engnova.home.roadmap: Coming next: a short survey, a daily plan, your first lesson.
